newsitem.title: USA: Playboy to launch Scandinavian edition.
newsitem.headline: Playboy to launch Scandinavian edition.

text.p: Playboy Enterprises Inc. plans to publish a Scandinavian edition of Playboy magazine in conjunction with a Scandinavian media company, the two companies announced Tuesday.

A bimonthly magazine will be distributed in Norway starting with the December 1997/January 1998 edition, and distribution in Sweden, Finland and Denmark is expected over the next few years, Playboy Enterprises and Media Holding ASA said.
The magazine agreement was signed Tuesday, the companies said.
The Scandinavian version of Playboy will be the 16th overseas edition of the magazine.
Playboy Enterprises is based in Chicago.
